# FlareCard

| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Child content rendered inside the card. Compose with FlareCardMedia / FlareCardHeader / FlareCardContent / FlareCardFooter / FlareCardActions. |
| `Compact` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | When true, lays the card out horizontally (media on the leading side, content beside it). Default false (vertical). |
| `Elevation` | `int?` | `` | Parameter |  | Overrides the card's drop shadow with an explicit elevation level (0-5 on the elevation scale, clamped). Elevation="0" is flat (no shadow); higher values lift the card further. When null (default) each Variant keeps its own elevation - Elevated is level 1, while Filled/Outlined/Tonal/Text are flat. The level is applied through the --flare-card-elevation variable rather than the final box-shadow, so a clickable elevated card still lifts on hover. |
| `Href` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | When set, the card activates as a link to this URL. An empty anchor is stretched over the surface rather than wrapped around the content, so nested interactive elements stay valid and independent. A link card cannot also be Selectable: one activation control cannot navigate and toggle, and no element is announced as both a link and a checkbox. The combination throws; put a checkbox in the card's content instead. |
| `OnClick` | `EventCallback<MouseEventArgs>` | `` | Callback |  | Click handler. When set (or Href), the whole surface becomes clickable through a native activation control, so nested buttons, links and fields keep their own clicks and keys, and keyboard focus shows on the card. On a link card the callback runs alongside the native navigation, which is not prevented. |
| `OnSelectionChange` | `EventCallback<bool>` | `` | Callback |  | Fired with the new selected state whenever the user toggles a selectable card. |
| `Selectable` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | When true, the card can be toggled selected; its activation control carries role=checkbox and the checked state. Selection shows an accent ring. Cannot be combined with Href - a navigating card and a selecting card are two different controls - and that combination throws instead of silently ignoring the selection. |

| `FillHeight` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Makes the component spend the height it was given rather than growing to fit its content, and pass that height on to its children. This is the screen-fit case - a grid under a filter bar, a chart beside a table, a page that fills the window instead of scrolling with it. It needs an ancestor with a height of its own, and EVERY link between that ancestor and this component needs the same switch: one link left at auto collapses the chain back to content height, silently. A page gets its first definite height from FlareLayoutContent FillHeight; anywhere else - a demo, a dialog - give the outermost box one explicitly. The box that SUPPLIES a height does not fill: when Style declares a height of its own, that height wins and this switch is ignored, because the two are contradictory instructions and the written number is the one you can see in the markup. Inherited from `FlareContainerBase`. |

## Methods

### `FocusAsync()`

Moves keyboard focus to the card root. The card must be focusable for this to do anything visible - pass tabindex="-1" through additional attributes.
Returns: `ValueTask`.
